description: "Where is [IP] located" / "what country is this address in" / "geolocate an IP" — IP geolocation via HackerTarget, returning country, state/region, city and coordinates for an address. City-level accuracy is approximate and a VPN or CDN address reports its datacenter, not its user. Use for coarse traffic attribution, never to locate a person.
name: geoip
title: Geoip
